rule.description: Release notes 应完整列出该版本中所有已集成并通过测试的功能，不应遗漏已合入的代码。对于并行推测等分类下的多种方法，应逐一列出。
checkpoints: 检查 release notes 是否遗漏了已集成的功能
确认所有通过 Q2 测试的功能是否都已记录
对于已知限制（如 PD 场景不支持 C8），应在文档中明确标注

## v0.22.1rc1 - 2026.06.30

### New Features

- [Feature] Added support for EPLB (Expert-level Load Balancing) for MoE models.
- [Feature] Added multi-token prediction (MTP) support for DeepSeek V3.
- [Feature] Added support for parallel speculation methods.
- [Feature] Added SSD support for multiple DP ranks on the same machine.
- [Experimental] Added SSD support for multiple DP ranks on the same machine
  to avoid local-rank path collisions in Mooncake offload directories.
  [#10477](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10477)

### Bug Fixes

- [Bugfix] Fixed KV cache pool memory leak issue.
- [Bugfix] Fixed precision issue with Qwen3.x PD + MTP.

## v0.22.1rc1 - 2026.06.30

### New Features

- [Feature] Added support for EPLB (Expert-level Load Balancing) for MoE models.
- [Feature] Added multi-token prediction (MTP) support for DeepSeek V3.
- [Feature] Added support for parallel speculation methods: P-eagle and PARD.
  The code for these two methods has already been integrated, and the methods
  have been fully implemented after passing Q2 testing.
- [Feature] Added SSD support for multiple DP ranks on the same machine.
- [Experimental] Added SSD support for multiple DP ranks on the same machine
  to avoid local-rank path collisions in Mooncake offload directories.
  [#10477](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10477)

### Bug Fixes

- [Bugfix] Fixed KV cache pool memory leak issue.
- [Bugfix] Fixed precision issue with Qwen3.x PD + MTP.
